title: Colloquial Persian Word Reductions
summary: How spoken Persian shortens vowels and verb endings in everyday talk.
explanation: Spoken Persian converts 'ân' sound to 'oon' (e.g. khâne -> khoone) and shortens verbs (e.g. mi-khâham -> mi-khâm).

common_error_explanations.err_red_1: Use natural spoken reductions in casual speech.
